item.text:
**Verdict:** Mixed, leaning negative. Erdoğan did follow through on some formal commitments in 2024, but the larger pattern was selective compliance, reversals, and heavy information control.

| Side | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Turkey’s Erdoğan signs off on Sweden’s NATO membership ratification | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-25 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-signs-off-on-swedens-nato-membership-ratification-3283398 | After a long delay, Erdoğan completed ratification of Sweden’s NATO accession, which is a concrete example of eventually honoring a formal international commitment. | 7B.8 |
| Positive | Erdoğan says March election will be his final one | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-03-09 | https://theprint.in/world/turkeys-erdogan-says-march-election-will-be-his-final-state-media-reports/1994063/ | Erdoğan publicly described the March 2024 local vote as his “final” election, which is weak but real acknowledgment of term-limit/succession norms. | 7B.8 |
| Positive | Erdoğan acknowledges AKP’s electoral setback and calls for self-criticism | AP | 2024-04-01 | https://apnews.com/article/08b72132244340176a3ef52e6d2da6ff | After the local-election defeat, Erdoğan publicly admitted the party had suffered a “loss of altitude” and needed self-criticism, which is a modest sign against pure denial. | 7B.8 |
| Positive | Türkiye co-sponsored ceasefire letter on Gaza | UN / UNISPAL | 2024-11-01 | https://www.un.org/unispal/document/joint-call-to-halt-arms-transfers-to-israel-signed-by-52-member-states-and-two-international-organizations-letter-from-turkiye-a-79-572-s-2024-802/ | Türkiye co-sponsored a formal call for an immediate and permanent ceasefire and protection of civilians, which counts as a concrete commitment rather than mere rhetoric. | 7B.8 |
| Positive | Turkey said it would open the Yayladagi gate for safe, voluntary return | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765 | Erdoğan’s government announced a managed, voluntary-return approach for Syrians after Assad’s fall, which is limited but looks like a real fulfillment of a stated humanitarian line. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Erdogan ally floats Turkey constitutional amendment to let him extend his tenure | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/erdogan-ally-floats-turkey-constitutional-amendment-to-let-him-extend-his-tenure-3701715 | Erdoğan’s ally publicly proposed changing the constitution so he could run again in 2028, which cuts against respect for formal term limits. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey blocks access to Instagram platform but gives no reason | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-02 | https://theprint.in/world/turkey-blocks-access-to-instagram-platform-but-gives-no-reason/2204688/ | The state blocked Instagram nationwide without explanation or duration, showing opportunistic control of public information rather than transparent, accountable decision-making. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey reported shocking confusion as it seizes earthquake survivors’ homes | Reuters | 2024-03-18 | https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/ | Thousands of Hatay property holders were blindsided by Treasury transfers under an urban-planning amendment with unclear compensation, suggesting concealed tradeoffs and opaque state action. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Türkiye government removes elected opposition mayors | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-07 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | HRW says elected mayors were removed, councils dissolved, and at least one case involved a secrecy order, which is strong evidence of neutralizing opposition mandates rather than honoring political outcomes. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey’s 2024 Digital News Report | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey | The report says media control stayed tight, incumbents got disproportionate airtime, and critical outlets faced fines, supporting a pattern of manipulating public information. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey: Ensure Accountability for Deaths in Earthquake | Human Rights Watch | 2024-02-02 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/02/turkiye-ensure-accountability-deaths-earthquake | HRW says prosecutors cannot investigate public officials for duty-related crimes without executive permission, which is a structural barrier to independent accountability. | 7B.8 |
| Negative | Turkey: No Transparency on Earthquake Deaths Inquiry | Human Rights Watch | 2024-12-13 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/13/turkiye-no-transparency-earthquake-deaths-inquiry | The Interior Ministry tried to suppress disclosure on investigations into earthquake-related officials, though a court later allowed disclosure; overall this points to concealment attempts first, transparency second. | 7B.8 |

Search gap: I did not find a clean 2024 source showing Erdoğan consistently honored a broad domestic reform platform or maintained full transparency around tradeoffs. The strongest positive evidence is narrow and episodic, while the negative evidence is broader and more systematic.
